verdict.rationale: GitBook's docs show it renders OpenAPI specifications into interactive API reference pages: 'Interactive API playgrounds' are listed on the pricing page, and users can 'test endpoints right on the page with interactive blocks'. GitBook's own REST API reference is also published as docs. The probe 404s at guessed OpenAPI paths only concern where GitBook hosts its own spec, so they do not contradict the playground feature. Missing for 10: detail on runnable or auto-generated code samples, depth on playground behavior such as auth handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
